steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Tatjana! They broke the last Gramophone! There's nothing we can do against those giants!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Hey! The rioters started burning houses! Bastards... and the fire's spreading!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Where are Tatjana and Severin?! At a time like this!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz Severin is... wounded. He's resting.

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: He's resting while we're out here risking our lives—

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Quiet! We can't be fighting each other right now. Look around you, moron!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Who's a moron?! I don't see you doing anything with your Arts!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: S-stop! We need defensive Arts in place to regain control of each jurisdiction.

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Caster on the east side down! We need another one up there!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Careful!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Fire! Incoming!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Help meeaaaaaaaaahhh!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: P-put it out! Does anyone have some way of dousing the flames?!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: It burns! Help meee!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Tatjana... Save... me....

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Ahhh... Gaaaaahhhh!!
Any actual words are swallowed up by bloodcurdling screams.
The smell of charred flesh is among the most chilling odors one can experience.
The man, engulfed in flames, slowly loses his form, leaving behind only a darkened, shadow-like corpse.
He struggles to cry out as his skin sears and his blood boils.
He reaches towards me in unspeakable agony, begging me to save him.
But...
But... Did Thor go through that same pain?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Tatjana! Focus! You're too far out! Careful!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Lucky me! Another noble lapdog to burn alive!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Chaos. The town is all sliced up into nice little pieces, like a cake.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Now, the last piece is crumbling to bits. They can't stop us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: And even if we stopped ourselves. Even if we packed up and left. Do they really think they could survive?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Leithanien will leave them to die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The nearest nomadic city has 24 of those towers, and not a single lord can spare a glance for the dying little town in the Winterwisp Mountains.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Tragic.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: There was a time when we grew weary of such tragedy. Let's not forget, standing here.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Think things through.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Sure. Say, why don't you ever talk like this? I'm just complaining.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Complaining that we held out so long, biding our time, and nothing changed, in the end. It all went to hell.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's just so anti-climactic. I'm disappointed.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They're pushing in!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I- I'm coming!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Shit! Tough nut to crack!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Where did that Vulpo come from? Are those nine tails I'm seeing?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: No way! She's Infected! Why is she with them?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: So young... After all you've suffered, shouldn't you be fighting back?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Comrade! Don't be deceived! Fight the power!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: They are the criminals who chain and oppress us!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You... don't know anything!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: She, she sent them flying?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: The Arts around her slowed down? Where do those Arts come from? I've never seen it in the books.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You can't decide someone else's fate. Rhodes Island, Mom and Dad, everyone's always been so good to me!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: And you! Don't sneak up on me!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Agh...! I can't... move...!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hnng!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Stop...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Stop ruining things for everyone! Think about all the pain you're causing everyone else!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...So, what's next?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Biederman... the culprit is dead.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We have no hard evidence until Click and Ayerscarpe return...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Then who is the real killer? What is actually happening here?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Now is not the time to discuss that. We have to put down the riot first.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I... I don't know what to do...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It's ridiculous, ironic, and hopeless. A doctor dedicated to healing the Infected died in the midst of an Infected riot.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I've been fuming about it... more than anyone.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hnng!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Why? Why does it have to be this way? Why doesn't anyone know what's happening here?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Killing each other doesn't solve anything! You're all going to die!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Get out of my way! I will go through you if I have to, kid or not!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I'm not moving!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You have to listen to me!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Listen to what? Are you playing judge here? Who are you to determine what's right and what's wrong?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: How do you think we got here? Plenty of wannabe philosophers out there railing about the era, the country, and human nature. They don't know shit.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: But if you're walking down the road and a highwayman with a knife asks you for some charity...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Are you gonna have a heart-to-heart about Leithanien's corruption? Or about Rim Billiton's blood-soaked operations?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Uh oh...! I can't... hold out much longer...!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: He's thinking about how to kill you and get away with it. And you're thinking about whether you should shoot first, or try to put a little distance between you.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Nine times out of ten, you're just trying to make it out alive.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: There's always little people to sacrifice. Turns out they're people like us, not like you.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: You rest easy, talk about your ideals, complain about the shitty state of the world. You talk about the big picture. The real enemy is far away, so you don't deal with the problems right in front of you. Hah!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: It's working! Keep it up!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But you're all innocent! It's not like you all wanted this...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Innocent? Pfft. I don't need your sympathy. None of us are innocent. Piss off.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: We're doing what it takes to survive. Even if that means somebody else can't. There's no charity in survival.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hey! What's up with that nine-tailed Vulpo girl?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Target her! Quick!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Gah! My staff... it snapped! Where did that bolt come from?!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Ayerscarpe and Click should be out there evacuating civilians. As for us...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Reunion.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I know what I heard. They were cheering that Reunion liberated them.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But they're not...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: They're the core of this riot. Get rid of them and it falls apart!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If it weren't for them, Atro would still be alive!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Folinic!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This isn't your first time. It's not mine... either.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm just... at a loss.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let's go. Rhodes Island is going to find a way to stop this riot.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's Rhodes Island. You put all your hopes in a bunch of kids, huh?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're so green. They didn't even get here in time to stop all this. It's already over.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...But they are warriors.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Warriors, who have known the battlefield.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Have the others withdraw.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We will go.
The Sarkaz tears off the Reunion symbol and raises a hand, causing crumbling rocks to once again gather together.
The battlefield falls silent. The rioters give way, and the protesters retreat in fear.
Only Mudrock steps forward, but one step.
